# Hamdam

> Hamdam is a daily Persian poetry, reflection and journal app for iPhone, made in Brisbane, Australia. Each day it offers a verse from Hafez, Rumi, Saadi, Khayyam or Parvin Etesami, in the original Persian beside an English translation, with a reflection chosen by how the day feels on a five point mood slider. Free tier with 15 reflections per month; Hamdam Plus subscription and a one time Founding Companion purchase. Available on the Australian App Store (App Store ID 6784461990). No accounts, no sign up, no tracking; the private journal syncs only through the user's own iCloud, opt in.

Every claim in this file is drawn from the site itself. Verses are sourced from
Ganjoor.net and credited on every page. The site is bilingual: English pages at
the root, Farsi (RTL) pages under /fa/.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://hamdam.com.au/): what the app does, how a reflection is chosen, plans and pricing structure
- [Farsi homepage](https://hamdam.com.au/fa/): the same, in Persian
- [App Store listing](https://apps.apple.com/au/app/id6784461990): download page for iPhone

## The five poets

- [Hafez](https://hamdam.com.au/poets/hafez/): the Divan, Shiraz, c. 1325 to 1390
- [Rumi](https://hamdam.com.au/poets/rumi/): the Masnavi and the Divan-e Shams, 1207 to 1273
- [Saadi](https://hamdam.com.au/poets/saadi/): the Bustan and the Golestan, c. 1210 to c. 1291
- [Khayyam](https://hamdam.com.au/poets/khayyam/): the quatrains, mathematician and astronomer, 1048 to 1131
- [Parvin Etesami](https://hamdam.com.au/poets/parvin-etesami/): debate poems, 1907 to 1941

## Cultural moments

The app keeps a cultural calendar of Iranian, Afghan and Tajik moments plus
Australian public holidays by state. These pages carry the next dates:

- [Yalda](https://hamdam.com.au/moments/yalda/): the longest night of the year
- [Norooz](https://hamdam.com.au/moments/norooz/): the first day of spring
- [Chaharshanbe Suri](https://hamdam.com.au/moments/chaharshanbe-suri/): the fire jumping night before Norooz
